I'll reason as this farmer, then give the JSON.

My thinking:

I have 10.1 mu here in Quzhou. Same wheat-maize rotation I've been doing for 40 years. Two people in the house, so labor is tight — mostly just me and my wife. We have a well, that's good, water is not my biggest worry.

Last year wheat gave me about 480 kg per mu, maize about 580 kg per mu. Not bad. I'll mostly do the same this year, maybe small adjustments.

**Wheat (winter, about 10 mu):**
I'll plant the improved variety, 济麦 type — the seed dealer in town sold it last year and my neighbor 老王 got good grain from it. I buy about 15 kg seed per mu.

Base fertilizer before planting: I use one bag of 复合肥 15-15-15, that's 50 kg per mu. Then in spring at 返青-拔节 (green-up to jointing), I top-dress with urea, about 20 kg per mu. So total N comes to maybe 16-17 kg from that, but I also count what's in the compound — roughly 25 kg N per mu total. P about 8 kg, K about 8 kg per mu. That's what people around me use. Spend less and the wheat looks yellow in March — I've seen it.

Irrigation: I water before winter (冻水), then 春灌 green-up, and one at jointing-booting, and one at filling if it's dry May. Four times usually. Well water is cheap enough, the pump is mine.

Spray: herbicide once in spring for 野麦 and broadleaf weeds. Then one for 蚜虫 and 赤霉病 around flowering. Sometimes a third if 锈病 shows. Call it 2-3 times, I'll say 3.

Tillage: after maize I rotary-till the straw in, then plant. Rotary.

**Maize (summer, same 10 mu after wheat):**
Direct seed after wheat combine — no-till, 贴茬播种. Everyone does it this way now, saves time before the rains. Seed the 郑单 or 先玉 hybrid, about 3-4 kg per mu.

Fertilizer: one bag 复合肥 at planting (50 kg/mu 15-15-15), then urea top-dress at 大喇叭口 stage, about 20 kg per mu. Total N about 24-25 kg/mu, P 8 kg, K 8 kg. Maize eats a lot of N.

Irrigation: summer has rain, but if July-August is dry I water once at tasseling. Usually 1-2 times. I'll plan 2.

Spray: herbicide after seeding, then one spray for 玉米螟 and 草地贪夜蛾 — that new pest has been around. 2 times.

Tillage: no-till straight into wheat stubble.

Yields: aim for 500 kg wheat, 600 kg maize per mu. That's realistic for my land.

Maize goes in no-till right after wheat harvest with hybrid seed, same fertilizer pattern, one or two irrigations if July is dry, and sprays for borer and the new fall armyworm. My neighbors do similar amounts; cutting fertilizer to save a few hundred yuan is not worth a yellow crop. I aim for 500 kg wheat and 600 kg maize per mu, close to last year."
